� rāga-anuviddhaś
cetana-acetana-sādhana-adhīnaḥ sukha-anubhava iti tatra–asti rāga-jaḥ karma-āśayaḥ / Tathā
ca dveṣṭi duḥkha-sādhanāni muhyati ca–iti dveṣa-moha-kṛto'py asti karma-āśayaḥ / Tathā ca–
uktam / Na–anupahatya bhūtāny upabhogaḥ saṃbhavati–iti hiṃsā-kṛto'py asti śārīraḥ iti /
Viṣaya-sukhaṃ ca–avidyā–ity uktam / Yā bhogeṣv indriyāṇāṃ tṛpter upaśāntis tat sukham /
Yā laulyād anupaśāntis tad duḥkham / Na ca–indriyāṇāṃ bhoga-abhyāsena vaitṛṣṇyaṃ
kartuṃ śakyam / Kasmāt ? Yato bhoga-abhyāsam anu vivardhante rāgāḥ kauśalāni ca–
indriyāṇām iti / Tasmād anupāyaḥ sukhasya bhoga-abhyāsa iti / Sa khalv ayaṃ vṛścika-viṣa-
bhīta iva–āś
